newsitem.title: USA: Envirosource unit cooperating with inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Envirosource unit cooperating with inquiry.

text.p: EnviroSource Inc said on Thursday that its International Mill Service subsidiary was cooperating with an antitrust inquiry by U.S. Department of Justice, but was confident that the unit had not broken the law.
The Justice Department's antitrust division was inquiring into iron and steel slag processing in the United States and Canada, EnviroSource said.

The environmental services company said it conducted all of its operations in full compliance with the law and was confident the antitrust division would find International Mill Service had not violated the law.
